QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_33

question.text: Upon completion of winding-up of a Cat III AIF, the Certificate of Registration shall be:

answer.text: Retained by the Manager for 10 years

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that upon completion of the winding-up of the Fund by any of the processes set out, the Certificate of Registration shall be surrendered to SEBI. This is the clean closure requirement for a Cat III AIF. The Trap: Option A invents a manager-retention period; option B (auction to another AIF) and option D (transfer to the Trustee) are not contemplated by the winding-up framework. Note: Per workbook pages 356-358.
